title: The reconciliation_result owner and read, the rule set behind REC-04 and REC-05, the ACE product code and the local outcome record are not specified
source: Template and Rules v1 R7.2 and R9; Ownership Map entries reconciliation_result (P1), proceeds (P8), write_off (S7), rule_row (P7), JOB-04 (P1); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 41 and 44; context pack P8; legacy RWB-E4-050 sections 1, 2, 5, 8, 9, 12 and 15; FSD P8 v3 A2.11.3.1 and A2.11.4; TSD P8 v2 T5.1, T6.1 and T-A.1
section: 2 Business rationale; 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.7 Tables owned; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan; 15 Screens and states
description: Six sets of values this story needs are given nowhere in the sources read. First, the ownership of reconciliation_result: the legacy key writes the outcome row inside module P8 Payments and posting, while the Ownership Map records reconciliation_result and JOB-04 Reconciliation with P1 rwb-source-data on Architecture v5 slides 41 and 44, so the row is the owner's and no source read names the operation that lists its rows for a rec_code and a business date, the field names they carry or the result codes they take. Second, the rule set behind REC-04 and REC-05: both are named only in the legacy key, no rule set read defines them and no package is named, so the rule IDs and versions the local decision record must cite are unnamed. Third, the data product code that serves the v_ace_payment and v_ace_batch_status rows through the source-data products operation. Fourth, the trigger of the P8 side: the P8 ownership rows hold no reconciliation job and no consumed event, so the run is started from the batch completion record of the source and the activity name is a target name, not a source value. Fifth, the local outcome shape: the counts the legacy row reconciliation_result carries (DF-OPS-118 to DF-OPS-129) are the owner's, and no source says which of them the P8 record keeps beside its own two counts and the break list size. Sixth, two settings of the run, the page size of the read and the retry count, and the product-group value the counts are grouped by, none of which a source fixes.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-050 Data table names reconciliation_result with DF-OPS-118 to DF-OPS-129 and its Endpoints row says None; Ownership Map places reconciliation_result and JOB-04 under P1 rwb-source-data (Architecture v5 slides 41 and 44); no rule set in the read set names REC-04 or REC-05; TSD P8 v2 T5.1 lists INT-02 and INT-16 only, and T-A.1 lists no reconciliation operation.
owner_role: P1 rwb-source-data owner with the P8 owner, the solution architect and the data product owner
proposed: Keep reconciliation_result, its rec_code, its business date and the reconciliation workflow with P1 as the map records them; have this service compute and record the payment side, read the owner's result through its contract and write no row outside rwb_payment; pin the product code and the two unnamed read operations in the contract registry at the wave 3 entry check.
